Display terminology follows the actual section heading at A13:561: semissextil in Portuguese and semisextile in English. Canonical query key duodecile, aspect angle, natal meaning and unsupported alias behavior remain unchanged.

octile.pt: no seu mapa, a semiquadratura se associa à ação diante de resistência. ela expressa uma dinâmica ativa dentro de limites.
octile.en: in your chart, the semisquare is associated with action in the face of resistance. it expresses active dynamics within limits.
reviewNotes: The API key is octile. The SEMIQUADRATURA section describes action and resistance and says its dynamic qualities operate within defined limits; the profile keeps that general theme without the section's planetary examples.
A13:784-791 discusses a future crisis, its possible avoidance, and favorable results. Those predictions and outcomes are excluded; the profile does not add a stress or aspect-pair condition.

Display terminology follows the actual section heading at A13:764: semiquadratura in Portuguese and semisquare in English. Canonical query key octile, aspect angle, natal meaning and unsupported alias behavior remain unchanged.

sextile.pt: no seu mapa, o sextil indica facilidade, com potencial benéfico e construtivo. ele também pode trazer tensão se a energia envolvida não for liberada.
sextile.en: in your chart, the sextile indicates ease, with beneficial and constructive potential. it can also bring tension if the energy involved is not released.
reviewNotes: Adopted Class 11's facilitator/beneficial potential and qualification that tension can arise if energy is not released. Class 13's constructive and facilitating description was used compatibly. At 942-943 only the facilitation clause is adopted; certainty and event/outcome clauses sharing those lines and continuing through 953 are excluded.
Class 11's sign-pair examples and polarity classification at 165-190 were not adopted.

square.pt: no seu mapa, a quadratura descreve tensão e conflito entre energias, podendo apresentar um desafio ou exigir uma solução. pode ter efeito energizante ou manifestar-se como conflito ou bloqueio, dependendo dos planetas envolvidos, e também motivar a superação de dificuldades.
square.en: in your chart, the square describes tension and conflict between energies, potentially presenting a challenge or requiring a solution. it can have an energizing effect or appear as conflict or blockage, depending on the planets involved, and can also motivate overcoming difficulties.
reviewNotes: Adopted tension/conflict, challenge or solution, possible energizing/conflict/blockage effects, and motivation to overcome difficulties. Effects are qualified as possibilities.
Class 11 sign/modality lists at 211-213 and Class 13 lines 1066-1152 were inspected but not used; the latter's fatalistic, health, and relationship claims are excluded.

trine.pt: no seu mapa, o trígono sugere harmonia e facilidade entre as energias envolvidas, com potencial benéfico. como tende a não exigir tanto esforço, pode haver menos empenho e, conforme o tema, menor valorização.
trine.en: in your chart, the trine suggests harmony and ease between the energies involved, with beneficial potential. because it may require less effort, there can be less exertion and, depending on the subject, less appreciation.
reviewNotes: Adopted the harmony/benefit description and preserved the source's qualification that ease may mean less effort and, depending on the theme, less appreciation. No luck, wealth, or guaranteed outcome is claimed.
Class 11's triplicity relationship is not included. Class 13 lines 1292-1317 were inspected; its advice and fortune example were not adopted.

trioctile.pt: no seu mapa, a sesquiquadratura se associa ao esforço de elaborar dificuldades mentalmente. ela também põe em foco a busca de autoconhecimento.
trioctile.en: in your chart, the sesquisquare is associated with the effort to work through difficulties mentally. it also brings the search for self-knowledge into focus.
reviewNotes: The API key is trioctile; the source section is titled SESQUIQUADRATURA. A13:1377-1388 contains fractional-arithmetic errors and is not used for numeric prose. A13:1394-1396 gives the qualified natal clause about effort, difficulty, mental elaboration, and self-knowledge.

A13:1392-1396 says this discussion is more prominent in progressions than natal. Health, disease, pain, therapy, future-event prediction, and specialist progression claims are excluded. The later phrase at 1405-1408 about "these three angles" has an ambiguous antecedent and is not adopted.

Display terminology follows the actual section heading at A13:1376: sesquiquadratura in Portuguese and sesquisquare in English. Canonical query key trioctile, aspect angle, natal meaning and unsupported alias behavior remain unchanged.

quincunx.pt: no seu mapa, o quincunx se associa a ajustes. simbolicamente, ele pode representar uma força mediadora entre opostos.
quincunx.en: in your chart, the quincunx is associated with adjustments. symbolically, it may represent a mediating force between opposites.
reviewNotes: The API key is quincunx. A13:1563 gives the short adjustment gloss; A13:1434-1447 presents the mediation-between-opposites idea in a philosophical Jung/Plato discussion, so the copy marks this as symbolic rather than a guaranteed personal result.
A13:1410-1414 and 1455-1466 attach health, disease, cure, therapy and illness outcomes to this aspect. All such claims, neighboring aspect types and any guaranteed result are excluded.

A13:1452-1454 explicitly bridges the preceding philosophical image of opposites to the 150-degree aspect, tentatively. Its conditional symbolic status is preserved; the health clause beginning at1455 is excluded.

opposition.pt: no seu mapa, a oposição corresponde a planetas separados por 180 graus e formando uma linha reta. ela marca tensão entre dois polos.
opposition.en: in your chart, the opposition corresponds to planets separated by 180 degrees and forming a straight line. it marks tension between two poles.
reviewNotes: Class 13 at 405-406 and 1566 defines opposition through tension between poles. Class 11 at 287-290 instead describes a close relation and energetic harmony; following Mat's clarification, the harmony between positive/negative poles is recorded here in the audit only and is not inserted into the profile copy or used to classify signs.

parsFortunae.pt: no seu mapa, a Parte da Fortuna é um ponto virtual formado pela relação matemática entre Sol, Lua e Ascendente. ela aponta o que pode vir mais pela sorte que pelo esforço, incluindo bens, prestígio e reputação, em uma leitura que considera a posição e as relações planetárias do ponto e de seu regente.
parsFortunae.en: in your chart, the Part of Fortune is a virtual point formed by the mathematical relationship between the Sun, Moon, and Ascendant. it points to what may come more through good fortune than effort, including possessions, prestige, and reputation, read in light of the placement and planetary relations of the point and its ruler.
reviewNotes: Adopted the virtual-point definition and its Sun/Moon/Ascendant relation, the source's potential-baggage framing for possessions, prestige, and reputation, and the qualification to consider location, relationships, and ruler.

The passage attributes luck-related importance and attainment beyond effort to Valens; the profile preserves potential framing and makes no fortune guarantee. The natal point is not conflated with the whole Ark Annu 10 Wheel of Fortune.

Planetary relations are stated explicitly to avoid confusing the interpretive qualification with interpersonal relationships. A10:2567-2569 names the point's relation by sign with planets;2574-2578 includes the ruler's placement and relations. Bodily vitality is not inferred from the source's broader physical-body/life themes.

chiron.pt: no seu mapa, Quíron apresenta a imagem simbólica do curador ferido: reconhecer a própria vulnerabilidade pode ajudar a compreender a dor alheia. a imperfeição inevitável da condição humana se liga a temas de aceitação, perdão e compaixão.
chiron.en: in your chart, Chiron presents the symbolic image of the wounded healer: recognizing your own vulnerability may help you understand others' pain. the inevitable imperfection of the human condition is linked with themes of acceptance, forgiveness, and compassion.
reviewNotes: Adopted the source's symbolic wounded-healer image: recognizing one's own vulnerability may support understanding others' pain. The inevitable human-imperfection qualification, acceptance, forgiveness and compassion are preserved without a prescribed sequence or promised healing.

The Hercules/Kíriom myth is context for the metaphor, not a fixed biography or event assigned to a chart owner. No wound, illness, diagnosis, cure, relationship outcome, or healing guarantee is asserted; age/cycle and later placement-specific material are outside this concept profile.

The supplemental book at books/astrologia-hermetica/astrologia-hermetica.md:5756-5774 groups Chiron among software extras and calls the displayed collection spatial noise, with major transits named nearby at5784. This is limited methodological context, not a contrary Chiron natal profile; it provides no adopted personality wording and does not override the primary course.

A15:207-216 recommends considering Chiron with Pluto in a spiritual system. This is retained as contextual qualification without generating an unapproved planet-pair interpretation. Sun harmony/disharmony at192-200 and transits/cycles are not generalized into this concept.

lilith mean.pt: no seu mapa, Lilith representa simbolicamente uma área da consciência obscura e pouco acessível, figurada pela ausência de luz. a interpretação depende do conjunto do mapa e do grau, com características latentes que podem aparecer em intensidades diferentes, sem necessariamente chegar ao extremo.
lilith mean.en: in your chart, Lilith symbolically represents an obscure, difficult-to-access area of consciousness, figured as an absence of light. interpretation depends on the overall chart and degree, with latent characteristics that may appear at different intensities without necessarily reaching an extreme.
reviewNotes: Adopted the symbolic darkness/absence-of-light image for an obscure, difficult-to-access area of consciousness. Retained the actual qualifications: interpretation depends on chart/degree; intensity differs (152-155); characteristics are latent and need not reach extremes (159-160), rather than assuming total dormancy.

Excluded physical-vacuum claims, gendered odd/even moral classifications, corruption/evil/illegal labels, and practices. Priapus remains separate; the passage itself says it is not invariably opposite Lilith.

The cited concept does not distinguish mean and true calculation modes. Both verified chart keys share this one textual factor: the sole canonical record is lilith mean, with an explicit lilith true interpretation lookup alias. This does not equate their calculated positions and does not define a bare lilith default.

vertex.pt: no seu mapa, o Vértice aponta para o que você é, ou pode ser, além das circunstâncias externas, e costuma ser descrito como um ascendente espiritual. encontros ou eventos ligados a ele podem parecer predestinados e trazer algum tipo de iluminação pessoal, nem sempre em relacionamentos: também podem vir por trabalho, projetos criativos ou revelações pessoais.
vertex.en: in your chart, the Vertex points to what you are, or may become, beyond external circumstances, and it is often described as a spiritual ascendant. encounters or events tied to it may feel fated and bring some kind of personal illumination, not always in relationships: they may also come through work, creative projects or personal revelations.
reviewNotes: Adopted 849-896: spiritual ascendant, contrast with the ordinary Ascendant, fated-feeling encounters, not always relationships. Fated language kept as felt sense, not prediction.
Excluded: health problems as an example of activation (860), the comic-book caption (884), 'before/after' life-division claims (871-874, repeated in 916-919).

antivertex.pt: no seu mapa, o Antivertex aponta para o descendente espiritual: o outro, visto pela essência mais profunda da alma. se você estiver pronto para isso, o contato com o seu Antivertex pode ser mais poderoso do que outros contatos numa sinastria amorosa e pode ressoar por anos, mas, sem prontidão espiritual, o contato pode dar em nada.
antivertex.en: in your chart, the Antivertex points to the spiritual descendant: the other, seen through the deepest essence of the soul. if you are ready for it, contact with your Antivertex may be more powerful than other contacts in a romantic synastry and may resonate for years, but without spiritual readiness the contact may come to nothing.
reviewNotes: Adopted 898-912: spiritual descendant, the 'other' via soul essence, readiness caveat. Hedged ('may').
Excluded: 'absolutely crucial for soul development' stated as fact, softened out; Hamlet quote.

Aries.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Áries, você tende a buscar atividade e expressar iniciativa. nesse tema, sua expressão pode ser assertiva, pioneira e corajosa.
Aries.en: with the Part of Fortune in Aries, you may seek activity and express initiative. in this area, your approach may be assertive, pioneering, and courageous.
reviewNotes: Reframed activity and initiative as a chart tendency; the sign-mode clause supports assertive, pioneering, courageous expression. Excluded the claim that obstacles will be overcome and the assurance of sufficient energy/independence.
Table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes experience field from manner; only the sign-manner clause is used, not house-field content.

Taurus.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Touro, você busca coisas sólidas e duradouras, junto de renovação e crescimento. nesse tema, sua expressão pode ser paciente e constante, buscando estabilidade sem pressa.
Taurus.en: with the Part of Fortune in Taurus, you seek solid, lasting things alongside renewal and growth. in this area, your approach may be patient and steady, seeking stability without haste.
reviewNotes: Kept the introductory source's renewal and growth nuance with its search for solid, lasting things, then paired it with the sign-manner passage on patience, constancy, and stability.

The table's house-field text at 2848-2849 is not attributed to Taurus and was excluded. The source's claim that transformations are for the better and its directive were not turned into guaranteed outcomes or advice.

Gemini.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Gêmeos, você pode agir e reagir rapidamente às mudanças e lidar com o que parece temporário. nesse tema, sua expressão pode ser versátil e comunicativa, aberta a adaptar, questionar e aprender.
Gemini.en: with the Part of Fortune in Gemini, you may respond quickly to change and engage with what seems temporary. in this area, your approach may be versatile and communicative, open to adapting, questioning, and learning.
reviewNotes: Reframed the source's rapid response to change and apparently temporary conditions as tendencies; the sign-manner clause supports versatile, communicative, adaptive, questioning, learning-oriented expression.
Table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes experience field from manner; no house-field claim is used. The directive to avoid being a judge is omitted.

Cancer.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Câncer, você se volta à simplicidade e à capacidade de criar e doar. há também um vínculo íntimo com os começos e com sentir-se parte da própria criação.
Cancer.en: with the Part of Fortune in Cancer, you turn toward simplicity and the capacity to create and give. there is also a close connection with beginnings and with feeling part of your own creation.
reviewNotes: Adopted simplicity, creation/giving capacity, and close association with beginnings and feeling part of one’s own creation from the introductory passage. The nearby table sign-manner clause at 2873-2876 was inspected but is not cited or used because those claims are not in the profile.
Table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes experience field from manner; private-home field content is not used as sign meaning. Happiness/satisfaction is not promised as an outcome.

Leo.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Leão, você tende a buscar destaque e a contribuir para melhorar a sociedade. você pode expressar criatividade, estilo próprio, orgulho e dignidade nesse tema.
Leo.en: with the Part of Fortune in Leo, you may seek distinction and contribute to improving society. you can express creativity, individual style, pride, and dignity in this area.
reviewNotes: Reframed aspiration to stand out and improve society as an impulse, with the sign-manner clause supporting creativity, personal style, pride, and dignity. Excluded the source's directives about adapting others and giving advice.
Table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes experience field from manner; no house-field claim is used.

Virgo.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Virgem, você pode ser sensível ao ambiente e manter a atenção no aqui e agora. nesse tema, você pode procurar manter-se conscientemente ocupado, aperfeiçoando o que faz com análise e discernimento.
Virgo.en: with the Part of Fortune in Virgo, you may be sensitive to your surroundings and keep your attention on the here and now. in this area, you may seek to stay consciously engaged, refining what you do through analysis and discernment.
reviewNotes: Reframed source language about sensitivity to the environment, here-and-now focus, and being constantly/consciously occupied as a tendency, then included the sign-manner themes of improvement, dedicated work, analysis, and discernment. This is conscious engagement, not generic steadiness or advice.
The table’s health/day-to-day field at 2897-2900 is excluded; the adopted sign-manner clause is 2902-2907.
Conscious engagement concerns the manner of dealing with the point's topic, not employment as an inferred house-six domain.

Libra.pt: você tende a buscar harmonia e beleza ao partilhar experiências e cooperar com outras pessoas. a busca por reconhecimento e aceitação social pode afastar você da expressão da sua personalidade, enquanto decisões próprias aparecem como uma necessidade.
Libra.en: you tend to seek harmony and beauty by sharing experiences and cooperating with others. the search for recognition and social acceptance can draw you away from expressing your personality, while making your own decisions appears as a need.
reviewNotes: The sign-specific prose says seeking recognition and social acceptance can lead you not to express your real personality, and separately says you should make your own decisions. Both are rendered as a possibility or need, without adding a causal benefit or adopting the instruction.

The table context at 2822-2823 states that the first column is the field of experience and the second is the manner. Only the Libra sign-column manner at 2919-2923 is used; the house-column relationship content at 2911-2917 is excluded.

Scorpio.pt: você tende a perceber transformação e crescimento, buscando os mistérios com intensidade e afinidade com as forças da natureza. pode encontrar satisfação ao esclarecer outras pessoas e ajudá-las a enxergar novos caminhos.
Scorpio.en: you tend to notice transformation and growth, approaching mysteries intensely and feeling an affinity with the forces of nature. you may find satisfaction in clarifying things for others and helping them see new paths.
reviewNotes: The source describes strong perception of human growth and evolution, clarity about reality, harmony with nature, and happiness when clarifying and showing paths to others. The table's sign-column clause adds intensity, mysteries, and renewal; its imperatives are rendered as tendencies.
The table context at 2822-2823 assigns the first column to field of experience and the second to manner. The house-column introspection and death content at 2927-2931 is excluded.

Sagittarius.pt: você tende a valorizar possibilidades, curiosidade e uma perspectiva otimista, com energia para explorar sem se prender a limites. sua energia pode fluir melhor de modo descontraído e objetivo.
Sagittarius.en: you tend to value possibilities, curiosity and an optimistic outlook, with energy to explore without feeling confined by limits. your energy may flow more easily in an informal and straightforward manner.
reviewNotes: The prose describes avoiding situations that limit possibilities, curiosity, energy that flows better without ceremony and with objectivity, and an optimistic outlook. The source's caution against transferring personal happiness to others is not turned into a fixed trait or advice.

The table context at 2822-2823 assigns the first column to field of experience and the second to manner. The sign-column broad perspective and adventure at 2948-2951 are used; house-column travel, philosophies, and religion at 2941-2946 are excluded.

Capricorn.pt: você pode trazer ambição e esperança para seus objetivos, desenvolvendo força interior e senso de que sua vida está em suas próprias mãos. contribuição social e realização por esforço próprio e valor interior podem marcar esse modo de buscar sucesso.
Capricorn.en: you may bring ambition and hope to your goals, developing inner strength and a sense that your life is in your own hands. social contribution and achievement through your own effort and inner worth can mark this way of seeking success.
reviewNotes: The prose connects ambition and hope with overcoming restrictions imposed in youth, developing inner power and agency, social contribution, and objectives reached through one's own efforts and inner worth. The description keeps these as possibilities, not a fixed biography or guaranteed success.

The source table OCR interleaves the Capricorn house and sign columns at 2955-2959, 2963-2964, and 2966. The table citations are split into exact single-line sign-column clauses at 2962, 2965, and 2967; the interleaved house-column lines are excluded.

Aquarius.pt: você tende a explorar experiências fora dos limites da sociedade estabelecida, com senso de justiça, abertura e independência. originalidade, ideias coletivas e estímulos diferentes podem renovar sua maneira de abordar uma questão.
Aquarius.en: you tend to explore experiences beyond the limits of established society, with a sense of fairness, openness and independence. originality, collective ideas and different stimuli can renew how you approach a question.
reviewNotes: The source describes experiences outside established society, fairness, lack of prejudice, freedom, and nonconformity. The table adds originality, collective orientation, renewal of vision, and different stimuli. These are rendered as tendencies.

The source's claim that everyday problems will resolve themselves at 2817-2818 is excluded as an absolute guarantee. The table context at 2822-2823 assigns the first column to field of experience and the second to manner; house-column friends, projects, and cooperation at 2971-2975 are excluded.

Pisces.pt: você tende a valorizar promessas que possa cumprir e pode encontrar alegria em níveis elevados de consciência. a intuição, a fé e a visão interior podem orientar você para além do que é visível.
Pisces.en: you tend to value promises you can keep and may find joy in higher levels of consciousness. intuition, faith and inner vision can guide you beyond what is visible.
reviewNotes: The prose says you do not like making promises you cannot keep and connects joy with elevated levels of consciousness. Only the sign-column clauses support intuition, openness beyond what can be seen, faith, and inner vision; no dreams or images are included because those occur in the house column.

The source's absolute claim that everything imagined becomes part of reality at 2821 is excluded. The table context at 2822-2823 assigns the first column to field of experience and the second to manner; house-column interior exploration, dreams, reserve, and isolation at 2986-2992 are excluded.

Aries.pt: com Lilith em Áries, você pode sentir impulsos difíceis de explicar para iniciar, liderar ou buscar estímulos novos, com vontades que mudam de um momento para outro. pode precisar de liberdade para decidir e agir, e buscar reconhecimento; em tensão, a iniciativa pode vir acompanhada de indecisão.
Aries.en: with Lilith in Aries, you may feel hard-to-explain impulses to begin, lead, or seek new stimulation, with desires that shift from one moment to the next. you may need freedom to decide and act, and seek recognition; under tension, initiative may come with indecision.
reviewNotes: The source qualifies these traits by chart, degree, and supporting indications, and describes them as latent rather than necessarily extreme (152-155, 159-160). Violence, family outcomes, and sexual excess were excluded.

Taurus.pt: com Lilith em Touro, você pode perceber os sentidos com intensidade e se ligar ao conforto, à segurança e aos prazeres do corpo. pode haver uma necessidade de ter e possuir; em tensão, isso pode se tornar acúmulo compulsivo, ciúme ou dificuldade de manter a perspectiva.
Taurus.en: with Lilith in Taurus, you may experience the senses intensely and feel drawn to comfort, security, and bodily pleasures. there may be a need to have and possess; under tension, this may become compulsive accumulation, jealousy, or difficulty keeping perspective.
reviewNotes: The source says Lilith is well placed in Taurus; the summary's Taurus line is sexualized, so it was not used as a generic description. Health claims, resource outcomes, and sexual excess or lack were excluded.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Gemini.pt: com Lilith em Gêmeos, você pode viver uma relação emocional particular com a comunicação, os estudos e as conexões próximas, expressando pensamentos e sentimentos de um jeito próprio. a curiosidade sobre a vida dos outros e a persuasão podem se destacar, mas você também pode ter dificuldade para manter a concentração e se comunicar em harmonia com os outros.
Gemini.en: with Lilith in Gemini, you may have a distinctive emotional relationship with communication, study, and nearby connections, expressing thoughts and feelings in your own way. curiosity about other people's lives and persuasion may stand out, but you may also find it hard to concentrate and communicate harmoniously with others.
reviewNotes: The summary's Gemini phrase concerns sexuality and was excluded as a generic Lilith statement. Sibling rejection, school distress, and mental-health labels were omitted.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Cancer.pt: com Lilith em Câncer, você pode viver de um jeito particular os vínculos emocionais com a família, as origens e a vida privada. o passado e o lar podem ocupar um lugar emocional particular; dependendo dos aspectos, pode haver vulnerabilidade ou frustração nesse campo.
Cancer.en: with Lilith in Cancer, you may experience emotional ties to family, origins, and private life in a distinctive way. the past and home may hold a distinctive emotional place for you; depending on the aspects, there may be vulnerability or frustration in this area.
reviewNotes: Retains the passage's dependency on related aspects for vulnerability and domestic difficulty. Mediumship, paranoia, traumatic memories, belonging claims, and family dependency were excluded.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Leo.pt: com Lilith em Leão, você pode sentir necessidade de respeito, reconhecimento e autonomia, levando a sério a expressão dos seus talentos e a criação. pode temer não ser reconhecido e, em outros momentos, exagerar na autopromoção; prazer e diversão também podem variar em intensidade.
Leo.en: with Lilith in Leo, you may feel a need for respect, recognition, and autonomy, taking the expression of your talents and creativity seriously. you may fear not being recognized and, at other times, exaggerate self-promotion; pleasure and enjoyment may also vary in intensity.
reviewNotes: The source also discusses children, sex, anger, spending, pregnancy fears, and rejection; these sensitive or outcome-like claims were excluded. Autonomy and talent development are presented as source recommendations, not guaranteed results.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Virgo.pt: com Lilith em Virgem, você pode seguir horários e deveres com rigor em algumas atividades ou fases da vida e não seguir regras nem horários em outras. você pode ser detalhista e ter insights surpreendentes, mas também se perder nos detalhes; interferências emocionais podem dificultar o cumprimento do que planejou.
Virgo.en: with Lilith in Virgo, you may follow schedules and duties strictly in some activities or phases of life and disregard rules or schedules in others. you may be attentive to detail and have surprising insights, but also get lost in details; emotional interference may make it harder to follow through on what you planned.
reviewNotes: The opening line's diagnostic labels and body-related claims (443-444, 459-461) were excluded. The source's possible effects on work and pet preferences were also omitted.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Libra.pt: você pode desejar vínculos profundos que combinem paixão e intensidade com amor gentil, inclusivo e companheiro, embora possa ter dificuldade para construir harmonia. você pode sentir necessidade de ser amado e considerado, recear falhar ou assumir compromissos, e ter dificuldade para pedir ajuda.
Libra.en: you may want close bonds that combine passion and intensity with gentle, inclusive, companionate love, though you may find it hard to create harmony. you may feel a need to be loved and valued, fear failure or commitment, and find it hard to ask for help.
reviewNotes: Retém desejo de vínculo e dificuldade de harmonia sem afirmar que todos terão medo de compromisso.
Omite dependência, beleza/status, dramatização e permanência forçada em casamento; não transforma em resultado garantido.
A fonte recomenda considerar Vênus (525), contexto de leitura do mapa, sem virar instrução no perfil.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Scorpio.pt: você pode viver relações íntimas com intensidade, nas quais poder e controle ganham destaque, e demorar a se desligar de suspeitas ou intuições até esclarecê-las. a busca por profundidade pode coexistir com medo de aprofundar e, se mal administrada, trazer complicações com parceiros.
Scorpio.en: you may experience intimate relationships intensely, with power and control taking prominence, and find it hard to let go of suspicions or intuitions until they are clarified. a search for depth can coexist with fear of going deeper and, if poorly managed, bring complications with partners.
reviewNotes: Mantém como possibilidade a intensidade, o destaque de poder/controle e o medo de aprofundar; não afirma que controle sempre ocorre.
Omite carma, ódio/ciúme obsessivo, morbidez, morte, magia e alegações financeiras ou sexuais específicas; não reproduz diagnóstico nem prevê conduta.
A fonte recomenda considerar Plutão e Marte (582-583), contexto de leitura do mapa, sem virar instrução no perfil.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Sagittarius.pt: você pode se ligar emocionalmente às crenças e ideais que considera corretos e, às vezes, ter dificuldade para acolher perspectivas diferentes ou perceber o ponto de vista alheio. pode haver curiosidade por temas filosóficos, religiosos, éticos ou metafísicos, junto com dificuldade de persistir na pesquisa que exigem.
Sagittarius.en: you may feel emotionally attached to beliefs and ideals you consider right and sometimes struggle to make room for different perspectives or see another person's point of view. you may be curious about philosophical, religious, ethical, or metaphysical subjects while finding it hard to persist with the research they require.
reviewNotes: A fonte usa rótulos duros como fanático e extremista, mas a redação resume a ligação emocional e a possibilidade de fechar-se a outras perspectivas sem atribuir identidade fixa.
Omite militância, conversão de pessoas, indiscrição e previsões de impedimento, mantendo apenas temas e tensões adotados; a fonte não qualifica todos como necessariamente presentes.
A fonte recomenda considerar Júpiter (636-637), contexto de leitura do mapa, sem virar instrução no perfil.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

Capricorn.pt: você pode desenvolver responsabilidade, seriedade, praticidade e competência útil à comunidade, enquanto a autocrítica e a exigência elevadas podem tensionar a vida pessoal e os relacionamentos. pode também sentir necessidade de controle, ter dificuldade em obedecer a ordens e buscar reconhecimento.
Capricorn.en: you may develop responsibility, seriousness, practicality, and competence that serve your community, while high self-criticism and self-demand can strain personal life and relationships. you may also feel a need for control, find it hard to follow orders, and seek recognition.
reviewNotes: A leitura junta capacidade potencial e seus custos descritos na mesma seção; preserva pode e não generaliza como resultado certo.
Não incorpora a seção explicitamente marcada em tensão (708-720), que traz circunstâncias adicionais como pais autoritários/ausentes; não usa atributos de Príapo como descrição individual.

A18 chama Capricórnio de masculino (667-670), enquanto a convenção geral de Mat apresenta Capricórnio como feminino/negativo (A2/A11). Mantém a divergência como fonte de convenções distintas e não escolhe uma delas como universal nem a chama de typo.

Aquarius.pt: você pode ter uma relação emocional particular com grupos, projetos e amizades, com forte necessidade de independência e liberdade. o envolvimento profundo pode ser algo que você deseja e teme, e podem surgir dificuldades com regras ou com a convivência em grupos.
Aquarius.en: you may have a distinctive emotional relationship with groups, projects, and friendships, with a strong need for independence and freedom. deep involvement may be something you both desire and fear, and difficulties with rules or group relationships may arise.
reviewNotes: Resume o envolvimento explicitamente desejado e temido e a necessidade de liberdade como possibilidades.
Exclui atribuições médicas e corporais (coordenação, espasmos, tornozelo/perna) e os rótulos de egocentrismo/vitimização; não transforma a configuração em diagnóstico.
A fonte recomenda considerar Urano (773), contexto de leitura do mapa, sem virar instrução no perfil.

Pisces.pt: você pode reagir com autossabotagem ou hipersensibilidade e viver sentimentos de rejeição de forma cíclica. pode também demonstrar amorosidade e compreensão do ser humano, com sensibilidade ao ambiente e possível desgaste diante de situações e pessoas negativas, além de confusão emocional ou arrependimentos.
Pisces.en: you may react with self-sabotage or hypersensitivity and experience feelings of rejection cyclically. you may also show compassion and understanding of others, with sensitivity to your surroundings and possible exhaustion around negative situations and people, as well as emotional confusion or regret.
reviewNotes: Retém a fonte sobre rejeição cíclica, mas qualifica como pode; não apresenta as imagens extremas da introdução como previsão inevitável.
Omite reclusão e frustração (814) e alegações de ilegalidade/imoralidade, problemas psíquicos, telepatia/mediunidade, vícios e traição (815-820); sem previsão de saúde ou diagnóstico.
A fonte recomenda considerar Netuno e Júpiter (821-822), contexto de leitura do mapa, sem virar instrução no perfil.

A18:152-155 e159-160 condiciona a intensidade ao conjunto do mapa e ao grau; características latentes não precisam chegar ao extremo. As possibilidades do perfil não estabelecem biografia nem intensidade automática.

1.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 1, sua realização pessoal, seu autoconhecimento e a expressão da sua personalidade ganham destaque. concentrar atenção e energia em uma coisa por vez e não se preocupar demais com a imagem que os outros têm de você aparecem como temas de aprendizado.
1.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 1, personal fulfillment, self-understanding, and expressing your personality come into focus. concentrating attention and energy on one thing at a time and not worrying too much about how others see you appear as learning themes.
reviewNotes: Primary passage is instructional; represented its learning themes without turning them into fixed traits. Table HOUSE field clause adds personal realization, self-understanding, and personality expression.
Used only the HOUSE field description; no sign-manner language was imported.

2.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 2, o campo envolve valores pessoais e uso de talentos, além de realizações práticas ligadas à segurança. também entram em foco reconhecer seu valor e separar o que é seu do que pertence aos outros.
2.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 2, the field involves personal values and the use of talents, along with practical accomplishments connected to security. recognizing your own worth and distinguishing what is yours from what belongs to others also come into focus.
reviewNotes: Recast the primary learning directives as topics in focus. The HOUSE column includes personal values/talents and practical accomplishments/security.
The separate SIGN manner column was excluded; no Taurus manner is attributed to House 2.

3.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 3, sua realização se associa ao conhecimento, à interação, à comunicação e à mobilidade. sua segurança se liga ao pensamento, e não às coisas materiais, e distinguir sonho e realidade aparece como tema de aprendizado.
3.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 3, your fulfillment is associated with knowledge, interaction, communication, and mobility. your security is linked to thought rather than material things, and distinguishing dreams from reality appears as a learning theme.
reviewNotes: Recast the primary distinction between thought and material things, and between dream and reality, as interpretive themes rather than directives. The HOUSE field supplies knowledge, interaction, communication, and mobility.
Excluded the instruction not to judge others; did not import Gemini sign manner.

4.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 4, sua realização se associa à privacidade, às pessoas queridas e a um lar onde você se sente bem. concretizar em vez de apenas sonhar e ter princípios sólidos são temas de aprendizado, com possível frustração quando há precipitação.
4.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 4, your fulfillment is associated with privacy, people you care about, and a home where you feel at ease. making things happen rather than only dreaming and having firm principles are learning themes, with possible frustration when acting hastily.
reviewNotes: Preserved the source's qualification that haste can lead to frustration; expressed the directive about realizing rather than only dreaming as a theme, not advice. The HOUSE field supports privacy, loved ones, and a comfortable home.
The interleaved Cancer SIGN heading at 2869 was not treated as a House 4 meaning.
The unambiguous solid-principles clause is adopted; no modifier is transferred from principles to objectives.

5.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 5, sua realização se associa à criação, à autoexpressão, ao prazer e ao entendimento com filhos, quando houver. desejos e projetos aparecem associados à discrição e à seletividade.
5.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 5, your fulfillment is associated with creation, self-expression, pleasure, and understanding with children, where relevant. desires and projects are associated with discretion and selectivity.
reviewNotes: The HOUSE field supports creation, self-expression, pleasure, giving, and relating to children. The primary caution about desires and projects is described as discretion/selectivity, without turning its claim that desires tend to come true into a guarantee.
The interleaved Leo SIGN label at 2884 was not used as a house meaning.

The reflexive giving clause at2884-2885 is not recast as giving of oneself to others. It is omitted from copy/keywords; the other clear house-field themes suffice. Children remain a conditional topic, not a birth prediction.

6.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 6, sua realização se associa ao trabalho, à saúde e a pequenas ações diárias significativas. o esforço por um alvo e o afastamento dele podem aparecer como uma tensão, junto do aperfeiçoamento de suas habilidades naturais e da confiança na intuição.
6.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 6, your fulfillment is associated with work, health, and meaningful small daily actions. effort toward a goal and moving farther from it may appear as a tension, alongside refinement of your natural abilities and trust in intuition.
reviewNotes: The primary passage's absolute-sounding effort/goal statement is kept as a possible tension, not a guaranteed failure; its themes of natural abilities and intuition are retained without advice. The HOUSE field includes work, capacity, health as a domain, and meaningful/fulfilling daily actions, not health outcomes.
The interleaved Virgo SIGN label at 2898 was ignored; no Virgo manner was imported.
The source states distance from a goal, not merely feeling distant; no subjective-experience claim is substituted. The absolute statement is framed as a possible tension without guaranteed failure.

7.pt: você pode se voltar bastante para a felicidade das outras pessoas, às vezes com dificuldade para reconhecer o que realmente deseja. nas relações, entram em foco a escolha de uma companhia que não apenas afaste a solidão e a facilidade de ser influenciado.
7.en: you may focus strongly on other people's happiness, sometimes finding it difficult to recognize what you truly want. in relationships, choosing companionship that is about more than avoiding loneliness and susceptibility to influence also come into focus.
reviewNotes: The house-specific passage describes concern for others' happiness, greater concern for others than oneself, difficulty knowing one's own wishes, and susceptibility to influence. The table's house-column wording adds seeking a suitable person rather than using someone to avoid loneliness; imperative phrasing is not carried over as advice. No acceptance motive is attributed to House 7.

The table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes house field of experience from sign manner. The Libra sign-column material at 2914 and 2919-2923 is excluded. The wording does not promise relationship outcomes.

8.pt: você pode encontrar sentido na introspecção profunda e na investigação dos mistérios fundamentais da vida. humildade, flexibilidade e menor apego podem fazer parte desse modo de lidar com o que encontra.
8.en: you may find meaning in deep introspection and investigating life's fundamental mysteries. humility, flexibility and less possessiveness may be part of how you engage with what you encounter.
reviewNotes: The house-specific prose advises humility, flexibility and non-possessiveness, saying that giving up some ego may make a person happier. The table's house field emphasizes introspection and investigating life's basic mysteries. Advice is rendered as possible themes, not commands or guaranteed happiness.

The table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes house field from sign manner; Scorpio sign-column instructions at 2933-2937 are excluded. The source's mention of death at 2930-2931 is not turned into a prediction or outcome.

9.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 9, sua realização se associa a ampliar a compreensão do mundo por viagens, filosofia e religião. viver e trabalhar no cotidiano, fazer o necessário sem esperar recompensas e ter prazer nas próprias realizações aparecem como temas de aprendizado.
9.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 9, your fulfillment is associated with expanding your understanding of the world through travel, philosophy, and religion. everyday life and work, doing what needs to be done without expecting rewards, and enjoying your accomplishments appear as learning themes.
reviewNotes: Mat clarified on2026-11-16: retain both source functions as distinct field of fulfillment and learning theme. The everyday-life passage at2762-2763 is not silently substituted for the table field at2941-2946, nor is a new balancing mechanism invented.
The table HOUSE field is used; the Sagittarius SIGN manner at2948-2951 is excluded. No prediction, reward promise or practice instruction is added.

10.pt: você pode desejar aceitação da comunidade ou de pessoas em posição de autoridade, dedicando esforço constante ao que busca. sua contribuição ao mundo e um rumo profissional que faça sentido para você também são temas de realização.
10.en: you may seek acceptance from the community or people in positions of authority, applying sustained effort to what you pursue. your contribution to the world and a professional direction that feels meaningful to you are also themes of fulfillment.
reviewNotes: The house-specific source describes desire for acceptance by community or authority, constant effort, and a view that right and wrong are not absolute. Its final OCR-corrupt clause is excluded. The house-column table material connects fulfillment with contribution to the world and professional concerns with personal fulfillment; wording is qualified rather than made a guarantee.

The table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes house field from sign manner. Table OCR interleaves the Capricorn sign column; only house-column fragments at 2955, 2958-2959, 2963-2964 and 2966 are cited. Sign-column text at 2956-2957, 2960, 2962, 2965 and 2967 is excluded.

11.pt: você pode sentir inquietação e a impressão recorrente de que ainda há algo a fazer ou criar. amizades, projetos coletivos e a busca de soluções com outras pessoas podem ocupar esse campo da sua vida.
11.en: you may feel restless and repeatedly sense that there is still something to do or create. friendships, collective projects and seeking solutions with other people may occupy this area of your life.
reviewNotes: The house-specific prose says energy is unlimited and that it provokes restlessness, with a constant sense that something remains to be done or created. The absolute claim of unlimited energy is omitted, and the source's separate instruction not to feel trapped by social restrictions is not converted into a causal condition.

The table's house-column material addresses friends, projects, relating to people and finding solutions together. Its Aquarius sign-column language at 2977-2982 is excluded; no outcome or guaranteed success is claimed.

12.pt: períodos de recolhimento podem favorecer a reflexão sobre sua vida interior, seus sonhos e imagens. esse espaço também pode ajudar você a ponderar seus vínculos e objetivos, mantendo atenção às pessoas que dependem de você.
12.en: periods of solitude may support reflection on your inner life, dreams and images. this space may also help you weigh your connections and goals while remaining mindful of people who depend on you.
reviewNotes: The house-specific passage says periods of isolation can be beneficial for weighing relationships and objectives, and cautions against thinking only of oneself. Its final OCR-damaged wording is not interpreted beyond the clear reference to people who depend on you.

The house-column table associates fulfillment with inner understanding, dreams and images, with some reserve or isolation. Pisces sign-column manner clauses are excluded. This is framed as a possible reflective use of solitude, not relationship advice or an outcome claim.

4.pt: com o Vértice na casa 4, você pode se preocupar demais com a vida profissional e com a sua marca no mundo, quando precisa buscar força na família e nas bases. o Vértice pode trazer pessoas que o puxam para a vida sentimental.
4.en: with the Vertex in house 4, you may worry too much about professional life and your mark on the world, when you need to draw strength from family and foundations. the Vertex may bring people who pull you toward emotional life.
reviewNotes: Adopted 984-989 core tendency. Excluded: the 'empty at the end of life' warning (987-988), kept out as a near-prediction. Source says rare placement. No Antivertex text given for this house.

5.pt: com o Vértice na casa 5, você pode ser muito criativo e artístico, mas precisar desenvolver autoestima e coragem para confiar no que tem a oferecer. pessoas podem chamá-lo para projetos de entretenimento ou para orientar jovens, e o amor, o romance ou os esportes podem ser o caminho. o Antivertex cai na casa 11, o que pode indicar não perceber o quanto os amigos o aceitam e desejam.
5.en: with the Vertex in house 5, you may be very creative and artistic, yet need to develop self-esteem and courage to trust what you have to offer. people may call on you for entertainment projects or to guide young people, and love, romance or sports may be the way. the Antivertex falls in house 11, which may point to not noticing how accepted and wanted you are by friends.
reviewNotes: Adopted 925-937: creative/artistic, self-esteem and courage, projects and mentoring, Antivertex in 11. Excluded: 'sunny disposition is foreseen' (932) as predictive.

6.pt: com o Vértice na casa 6, você pode sentir forte necessidade de servir e de buscar experiências que ajudem os outros. o trabalho tende a ser muito importante, com ênfase em detalhe e precisão, e talvez em atividades que exigem talentos específicos. o Antivertex cai na casa 12, o que pode indicar forte intuição e a importância de sintonizar a mente superior para não se confundir nas ações.
6.en: with the Vertex in house 6, you may feel a strong need to be of service and to seek experiences that help others. work tends to matter a great deal, with emphasis on detail and precision, and perhaps on activities requiring specific talents. the Antivertex falls in house 12, which may indicate strong intuition and the importance of attuning to the higher mind so as not to become confused in action.
reviewNotes: Adopted 940-951. Excluded: health and medicine fields (944-945) and the meditation instruction (948-949, practice). Source heading text 'Trabalhador' not used.

7.pt: com o Vértice na casa 7, você pode dar muita importância a parcerias e ao equilíbrio nas relações, pessoais e profissionais, e sentir-se perdido sem alguém com quem interagir. o Antivertex cai na casa 1, o que pode trazer o lado empreendedor de iniciar projetos de forma independente, fonte de força e realização.
7.en: with the Vertex in house 7, you may give great importance to partnerships and to balance in relationships, personal and professional, and feel lost without someone to interact with. the Antivertex falls in house 1, which may bring the entrepreneurial side of starting projects independently, a source of strength and fulfillment.
reviewNotes: Adopted 953-965. Excluded: 'contentment in marriage is necessary for true happiness' (954-955), a deterministic relationship claim.

8.pt: com o Vértice na casa 8, você pode se voltar à exploração do oculto, dos segredos e dos mistérios da vida, e se envolver com estudos metafísicos. pode haver intensidade, capacidade de regeneração e de superar obstáculos, e mudanças dramáticas e poderosas. o Antivertex cai na casa 2, o que pode trazer períodos de dificuldade material em que você revê a autoestima e o autoconceito.
8.en: with the Vertex in house 8, you may be drawn to exploring the occult, hidden secrets and the mysteries of life, and become involved with metaphysical studies. there may be intensity, capacity for regeneration and for overcoming obstacles, and dramatic, powerful change. the Antivertex falls in house 2, which may bring periods of material difficulty in which you review your self-esteem and self-concept.
reviewNotes: Adopted 967-982. Excluded: psychic abilities, physical and sexual power (971-972), past-life meditation (970) and the named practices yoga/Reiki, per exclusion rules.

9.pt: com o Vértice na casa 9, você pode gostar muito do que lhe é familiar e da companhia de quem está por perto, como irmãos, vizinhos e amigos. talvez seja hora de ultrapassar seus limites e sair da zona de conforto, e o Vértice pode atrair pessoas que o convidem a isso.
9.en: with the Vertex in house 9, you may enjoy your surroundings and the company of those close by, such as siblings, neighbors and friends. it may be time to go beyond your limits and leave your comfort zone, and the Vertex may attract people who invite you to do so.
reviewNotes: Adopted 992-995. Source says rare placement. No Antivertex text given. 'Enteados' omitted.
Source content here reads like house-3 themes (neighbors, siblings); kept as written, flagged in notes.

Aries.pt: com Quíron em Áries ou na Casa 1, você pode perceber tensão entre afirmar sua independência e buscar aceitação dos outros. você também pode ser amável e sociável, com a aceitação de si entre os temas de aprendizado.
Aries.en: with Chiron in Aries or the 1st House, you may notice tension between asserting your independence and seeking others' acceptance. you may also be kind and sociable, with self-acceptance among the learning themes.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Aries/House 1 account. Retains its tension between seeking acceptance/acting for others and asserting individuality, with the gentler example’s independence theme.
Excludes childhood/adolescence as a presumed event, repression/trauma, self-harm or suicide references, therapist/healer claims, and guaranteed healing.

The gentler example at280-281 contributes kindness/sociability as well as independence/individuality; the presumed childhood-event clause at282-283 is not adopted. Self-acceptance is a learning theme, not a healing guarantee.

Taurus.pt: com Quíron em Touro ou na Casa 2, você pode sentir insegurança em torno do seu valor, do merecimento e da segurança material. a dor de perder e a culpa ao ganhar aparecem como temas dessa leitura, junto da busca por valores próprios.
Taurus.en: with Chiron in Taurus or the 2nd House, you may feel insecure about your own worth, deserving, and material security. pain around loss and guilt about gaining are themes in this reading, alongside the search for your own values.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Taurus/House 2 account. Preserves the specific sensitivity around loss, guilt in gaining, and personal worth at 372-375 as possible themes, not events or predictions; keeps material values/security in view.
Excludes body-image/health claims, financial pathology, and cure/healing promises.

Loss-related pain and guilt specifically about gaining remain distinct as stated at373; guilt is not reassigned to losing. These are interpretive themes, not asserted events or financial predictions. The self-worth clause is supported at388.

Gemini.pt: com Quíron em Gêmeos ou na Casa 3, você pode sentir insegurança nas próprias ideias, com a liberdade de expressão entre os temas importantes. uma mente versátil e rápida e um estilo próprio de comunicação podem conviver com dificuldade para falar do seu lado emocional.
Gemini.en: with Chiron in Gemini or the 3rd House, you may feel uncertain about your own ideas, with freedom of expression among the important themes. quick, versatile thinking and an individual communication style may coexist with difficulty expressing your emotional side.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Gemini/House 3 account. Uncertainty around one’s ideas/expression is paired with the source’s possible quick, versatile thinking and individual communication style.
Excludes school/childhood biography, diagnoses and stigmatizing claims, sibling illness or relationship predictions, and therapeutic/healing outcomes.

The insecurity clause concerns ideas; freedom of expression is a distinct stated need at409. The emotional-expression difficulty at418 qualifies the communicative strengths, without diagnosis or childhood explanation.

Cancer.pt: com Quíron em Câncer ou na Casa 4, você pode sentir uma ligação forte com a humanidade e insegurança diante da possibilidade de falhar. comunidade, raízes e a busca por um lar mais amplo também podem ganhar destaque.
Cancer.en: with Chiron in Cancer or the 4th House, you may feel a strong connection with humanity and insecurity around the possibility of failure. community, roots, and the search for a broader sense of home may also come into focus.
reviewNotes: This is the source's combined Cancer/House4 account. The first sentence retains humanity and insecurity around possible failure at431-435; the second retains community and the wider-home/roots themes at455-456. No fixed family history is inferred.

Excludes claims about a parent’s gender, rejection, abandonment, death, parental separation, childhood trauma, and relationship consequences. No universal house-parent convention or fixed family history is inferred.
A15:431-435 directly supports humanity, insecurity around failure and community;455-456 supports the wider-home/roots theme. No parent-gender convention or personal displacement event is inferred.

Leo.pt: com Quíron em Leão ou na Casa 5, você pode encontrar tensão entre o prazer de criar e a necessidade de ser reconhecido. seu estilo próprio e a possibilidade de incentivar a criatividade de outras pessoas também fazem parte desse tema.
Leo.en: with Chiron in Leo or the 5th House, you may find tension between the pleasure of creating and the need for recognition. your individual style and the possibility of encouraging other people's creativity are also part of this theme.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Leo/House 5 account. Retains creativity/self-expression/recognition as sensitive themes and the qualified possibility of supporting others’ creative development.
Excludes childhood repression or nonacceptance as presumed events, sexual/health claims, child or partner outcomes, therapeutic prescriptions, and promised healing or satisfaction.

The recognition-versus-creative-pleasure tension is grounded at468-473 rather than an invented motive. The helping-creativity theme at485-486 does not promise therapeutic, child or personal satisfaction outcomes.

Virgo.pt: com Quíron em Virgem ou na Casa 6, seu modo de trabalhar pode ser marcado pela atenção aos detalhes e pela cobrança de perfeição. seu desejo de ajudar pode conviver com o receio de que outras pessoas se aproveitem de você.
Virgo.en: with Chiron in Virgo or the 6th House, your way of working may be marked by attention to detail and demands for perfection. your desire to help may coexist with concern that others could take advantage of you.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Virgo/House 6 account. Retains work/detail/exacting standards and the tension between wanting to help and concern about being used as possibilities.
Excludes body dissatisfaction, illness, medical/therapeutic claims, dietary/exercise/meditation advice, hypochondria, and healing outcomes.
The fear of being used is retained as a concern, not as the source's guaranteed exploitation outcome. Work/detail/perfection and helping-versus-concern are grounded directly at492 and496-497.

Libra.pt: com Quíron na Casa 7 ou em Libra, você pode precisar bastante do contato com outras pessoas e nem sempre achar fácil flexibilizar sua própria posição. cooperar, dividir e reconhecer suas necessidades e seu espaço individual podem ser temas de aprendizado nas relações.
Libra.en: with Chiron in House 7 or Libra, you may need contact with other people and may not always find it easy to flex your own position. cooperation, sharing, and recognizing your needs and individual space may be learning themes in relationships.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 7 and Libra. Lines 529-530 describe a strong need for contact and learning to cooperate/share, with flexibility named separately at 531; lines 550-551 and 561-568 support personal needs and individual space. Copy does not turn cooperation into an innate preference or value, and does not claim rejection, childhood cause, partner behavior, separation or marriage outcome.

The source's therapist/cure language, sexualized framing, rejection biography, family and childhood claims, dependency scripts and imperatives are excluded. The shared sign-or-house portrait is not a claim that signs and houses are equivalent in all astrology.

Scorpio.pt: com Quíron na Casa 8 ou em Escorpião, você pode perceber tensões ligadas à sexualidade, aos valores espirituais e a sentimentos intensos, junto de questões de poder e controle. compreender a própria vulnerabilidade e partilhar recursos podem ser temas importantes nesse campo.
Scorpio.en: with Chiron in House 8 or Scorpio, you may encounter tensions involving sexuality, spiritual values and intense feelings, alongside questions of power and control. understanding your own vulnerability and sharing resources may be important themes in this area.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 8 and Scorpio. Lines 569-571 say sexuality and spiritual values may cause conflicts, without specifying that they conflict with each other; line 578 names intense feelings, line 575 power/control, lines 582-588 financial vulnerability, and 610-612 sharing resources. The copy preserves these as possible themes and does not claim the native's rejection, dysfunction, abuse history, partner outcome or deficient trust.

Excluded sexual dysfunction, abuse/incest/rape, birth or near-death trauma, illness, suicide, regression, clinical labels, therapist/healing claims, guaranteed recovery and imperatives. The mention of death is not turned into a prediction. Confidence in another person mentioned at 610 is not converted into a claim about the native's own trust.

Sagittarius.pt: com Quíron na Casa 9 ou em Sagitário, você pode buscar propósito e significado por meio de símbolos, ideias e diferentes filosofias. convicções distintas podem trazer desafios, enquanto comunicar conceitos abstratos e aprender a conviver com diferenças se tornam temas importantes.
Sagittarius.en: with Chiron in House 9 or Sagittarius, you may seek purpose and meaning through symbols, ideas and different philosophies. differing convictions may bring challenges, while communicating abstract concepts and learning to live with differences become important themes.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 9 and Sagittarius. Copy draws on symbolic/abstract communication, seeking meaning and purpose, the possibility of clashing with people who follow a different philosophy (619-620), and learning to live with differences (643-645). These are framed as a challenge and learning theme, not fixed intolerance or an assumed openness trait.
Excluded religious or spiritual prescriptions, guru exploitation, mental-health language, guaranteed cure/liberation, fixed beliefs or biography, and imperatives.

Capricorn.pt: com Quíron na Casa 10 ou em Capricórnio, você pode questionar que lugar ocupa no mundo e sentir pressão em torno de metas e reconhecimento profissional. a autocobrança pode acompanhar a busca por uma vocação própria, e diferentes formas de contribuir profissionalmente continuam tendo valor.
Capricorn.en: with Chiron in House 10 or Capricorn, you may question your place in the world and feel pressure around goals and professional recognition. self-pressure may accompany seeking your own vocation, and different forms of professional contribution still have value.
reviewNotes: This is the source's combined Capricorn/House10 account. Copy retains uncertainty about one's role, goals, professional recognition, self-pressure and vocation, then the qualification that different professional roles have value. It does not promise a rank, success, or a mentoring outcome.
Excluded claims about maternal rejection, parents, childhood, fixed therapist identity, inevitable professional failure/success, age or maturity timing, diagnosis and prescriptive career guidance.

The final qualification retains676-679: professional roles have value without ranking people as better or worse. It does not invent a desire for distinctive contribution or promise recognition, rank or success.

Aquarius.pt: com Quíron na Casa 11 ou em Aquário, você pode sentir sensibilidade em torno do pertencimento a grupos e da rejeição, junto de interesse por causas sociais. lidar com pessoas diferentes e com imperfeições na vida coletiva pode se tornar um tema importante.
Aquarius.en: with Chiron in House 11 or Aquarius, you may feel sensitivity around belonging to groups and rejection, alongside an interest in social causes. engaging with people who differ from you and with imperfections in collective life may become an important theme.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 11 and Aquarius. The copy retains group participation, social causes, rejection sensitivity and engaging with differences as possible themes, without asserting the person has experienced rejection.

Excluded guaranteed leadership, group success, fixed social or political identity, diagnosis, spiritual healing and imperative advice. The shared sign-or-house portrait does not establish universal sign/house equivalence.

Pisces.pt: com Quíron na Casa 12 ou em Peixes, você pode perceber frustrações coletivas e captar sentimentos alheios, com interesse pela vida interior e pelo que ultrapassa o visível. sonhos e imaginação podem funcionar como proteção, enquanto a atenção à vida prática também permanece importante.
Pisces.en: with Chiron in House 12 or Pisces, you may perceive collective frustrations and pick up on others’ feelings, with an interest in inner life and what goes beyond the visible. dreams and imagination may serve a protective function, while attention to practical life remains important too.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 12 and Pisces. Copy retains inner life, dreams as possible protection (742), the unknown, practical-life attention (727-729, 746) and sensitivity to collective frustrations/others' feelings as possible themes. The gentler combined example contributes only the narrow collective-frustrations clause at 288-289.

Excluded prenatal claims, drugs, depression, delusions, victim identity, carrying others' pain as fixed fact, spiritual healing promises, destiny/evolution language, and instructions. Citations at 713, 727-729, 740-742 and 746 include adjacent material not adopted; this note identifies the specific adopted clause portions and limits. The protective function is retained as source symbolism, not a clinical diagnosis or guaranteed coping outcome.

A15:714-716 supports interest in the unconscious/hidden realities; the prenatal clause sharing714 is not adopted. Dreams-as-protection is a possible function stated at742, not an instruction or clinical outcome.

mercury.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado, você pode achar difícil transmitir com clareza o que sabe e sentir que os outros não acompanham sua maneira de pensar. pode voltar a dúvidas até entender o assunto com profundidade; o aprendizado envolve manter a atenção no presente e expressar suas descobertas a partir dele.
mercury.en: with retrograde Mercury, you may find it difficult to convey what you know clearly and feel that others do not follow your way of thinking. you may return to questions until you understand a subject deeply; learning involves keeping attention in the present and expressing your discoveries from there.
reviewNotes: The course presents reincarnation and unresolved karma as its framework; the description does not assert past-life facts. Lines 555-564 describe separation as something learned, not an innate coldness. Excluded the sexual-orientation diagnosis at 591-595 and the unsupported universal idea of access to earlier universal ideas at 534-540.

venus.pt: com Vênus retrógrado, você pode internalizar mágoas e dar peso maior às imperfeições no amor, enquanto nem sempre reconhece com clareza o que sente ou prefere. a insegurança pode levar você a buscar proximidade e depois afastar os outros, enquanto padrões amorosos ligados ao passado podem se repetir.
venus.en: with retrograde Venus, you may internalize hurts and give greater weight to imperfections in love, while not always recognizing clearly what you feel or prefer. insecurity may lead you to seek closeness and then push others away, while love patterns linked to the past may recur.
reviewNotes: The course frames karma through a past-life account; the body recasts this as a symbolic pattern, not a verified biography. Excluded gendered claims and the sexual-orientation stereotyping/diagnosis at 1338-1348, as well as deterministic claims about love or relationships.

mars.pt: com Marte retrógrado, você pode ter dificuldade para coordenar pensamentos e ações, em contato imperfeito com suas próprias necessidades. pode projetar papéis imaginados do passado nas relações atuais e reagir com raiva, hostilidade ou desconfiança.

jupiter.pt: com Júpiter retrógrado, você pode desenvolver padrões próprios de justiça e ética, guiados mais por sua avaliação interior do que pelas opiniões ao redor. pode buscar a essência das ideias e preservar a individualidade; seu aprendizado envolve introspecção, suspender o julgamento dos outros e ter paciência ao expressar suas convicções.
jupiter.en: with retrograde Jupiter, you may develop your own standards of justice and ethics, guided more by your inner assessment than by the opinions around you. you may seek the essence of ideas and preserve your individuality; your learning involves introspection, withholding judgment of others, and patience when expressing your convictions.

saturn.pt: você pode levar a sério o que ainda precisa completar e voltar a tarefas que sente terem ficado inacabadas, agindo com reflexão e cautela. você pode sentir gratidão pelo que aprende, e a maturidade pode surgir com esforço pessoal; concluir lições com paciência e aplicar o que aprendeu são temas de aprendizagem.
saturn.en: you may take seriously what still needs completing and return to tasks you feel were left unfinished, acting thoughtfully and cautiously. you may feel gratitude for what you learn, and maturity may come through personal effort; completing lessons patiently and applying what you have learned are learning themes.
reviewNotes: The source presents unfinished past work, prior lives, God, and incarnation-specific karma as facts (3279-3287, 3295-3305, 3307-3314). Body reframes these as felt incompletion, gratitude, effort, and learning themes; it does not assert a past-life biography or divine debt.

uranus.pt: você pode resistir ao que sente que o prende e defender ideias originais, mesmo quando elas tornam difícil sentir-se compreendido ou acompanhado. pode haver conflito entre impulsos mentais e emocionais que apontam direções diferentes; expressar sua liberdade interior é um tema de aprendizagem.

reviewNotes: The source's personality passage calls for rebellion and predicts losses of friends, jobs, romances, and loneliness (3873-3888). Body retains resistance/originality and frames social cost as difficulty feeling understood, without guaranteeing losses.
The karma section's past-life independence claim (3914-3916) is excluded as fixed biography; the body retains only inner freedom and conflicting impulses as learning themes.

neptune.pt: você pode ter motivações difíceis de explicar aos outros e percepções mais ligadas à vida interior do que à realidade material; também pode viver uma espiritualidade intensa ou sentir grande afinidade com a música. um tema de aprendizagem é distinguir o que é real daquilo que parece realizar seus sonhos, integrando percepções e ideais sem projetar sonhos passados sobre o presente.
neptune.en: you may have motivations that are hard for others to understand and perceptions more connected to inner life than to material reality; you may also experience strong spirituality or feel a great affinity for music. a learning theme is distinguishing what is real from what seems to fulfill your dreams, integrating perceptions and ideals without projecting past dreams onto the present.

pluto.pt: você pode sentir os problemas da sociedade como um chamado pessoal à transformação interior e reagir fortemente à falta de honestidade das pessoas consigo mesmas. a consciência coletiva pode ocupar sua reflexão pessoal; desprender-se dos padrões e comportamentos alheios é um tema de aprendizagem ligado à sua identidade interior.

diurnal.pt: no seu mapa, o sect é diurno quando o Sol está acima do horizonte. nas profecções, o Sol é o luminar de sect associado aos nascimentos diurnos.
diurnal.en: in your chart, the sect is diurnal when the Sun is above the horizon. in profections, the Sun is the sect light associated with diurnal births.
reviewNotes: Aula 10 uses houses 7-12 as an illustration while explaining the Part of Fortune (2527-2529); that house range is not adopted as a general rule. The course defines above versus below the horizon but does not specify the exact-horizon boundary. The current implementation classifies using geometric altitude greater than its threshold, so an exact horizon is nocturnal; keep this source/implementation distinction in documentation.

nocturnal.pt: no seu mapa, o sect é noturno quando o Sol está abaixo do horizonte. nas profecções, a Lua é o luminar de sect associado aos nascimentos noturnos.

Aula 15's contrary southern-hemisphere inversion claim (33-45) is not applied to node identity; its dignity scheme (45-53) is retained as a separate symbolic correspondence. Leo.en: with retrograde Mercury in Leo, you may want to radiate your knowledge with authority to influence the future, and tend toward exaggeration and a silent envy of achievements you took no part in. your pride may keep you from asking for attention and from expressing what you know, and your strength lies in assessing the whole of situations where others see only flashes.

Virgo.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado em Virgem, você pode ser muito crítico ao olhar para o que já concluiu, comparando as falhas com o ideal que tem na mente, e parecer frio e rigoroso, tentando encaixar as pessoas nesses ideais. pode se sentir mais confortável com alguma distância dos outros, escolher poucos amigos e ter a habilidade de um pensador imparcial, bom em resolver detalhes.
Virgo.en: with retrograde Mercury in Virgo, you may be very critical when looking back at what you have completed, comparing flaws with the ideal in your mind, and seem cold and rigorous, trying to make people fit those ideals. you may feel more comfortable with some distance from others, choose few friends and have the skill of an impartial thinker, good at solving details.

Libra.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado em Libra, você pode oscilar nas decisões, de modo que quem está perto dificilmente entende sua posição, e se perguntar se pessoas do seu passado aprovariam o que decide agora. pode valorizar o tato e a diplomacia acima da verdade e temer a autoexpressão, mas por se colocar no lugar de cada um entende as situações de vários pontos de vista.
Libra.en: with retrograde Mercury in Libra, you may waver in decisions, so that people close to you hardly understand your position, and wonder whether people from your past would approve of what you decide now. you may value tact and diplomacy above truth and fear self-expression, but by putting yourself in each person's place you understand situations from many points of view.

Scorpio.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado em Escorpião, você pode ter uma mente muito aguçada, capaz de reexaminar as coisas e achar a profundidade que os outros não perceberam, o que favorece trabalhos de natureza científica. pode ser silencioso, guardar o que o incomoda, suspeitar dos outros e ser contundente, mas busca a verdade a todo custo, e sua mente funciona melhor quando voltada à busca espiritual.
Scorpio.en: with retrograde Mercury in Scorpio, you may have a very sharp mind, able to re-examine things and find the depth others did not notice, which favors work of a scientific nature. you may be quiet, keep to yourself what bothers you, be suspicious of others and blunt, yet you seek the truth at all costs, and your mind works best when turned to spiritual searching.

Sagittarius.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado em Sagitário, você pode ter dificuldade de concentração, interrompido por distrações, e tentar abranger tantos assuntos que não sabe quando começar a falar nem o que é relevante. a informação pode ficar superficial e dispersa e os pensamentos exagerados, mas curiosamente você pode ser um mensageiro místico para quem encontra.
Sagittarius.en: with retrograde Mercury in Sagittarius, you may have difficulty concentrating, interrupted by distractions, and try to cover so many subjects that you do not know when to start speaking or what is relevant. information may stay superficial and scattered and thoughts exaggerated, yet curiously you may be a mystical messenger to those you meet.
reviewNotes: Adopted the sign-specific tendencies; the source's retrograde phase (Fase I/II/III) jargon was left out. Lines 817-826, 829-830, 834-844.

Capricorn.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado em Capricórnio, você pode ser um pensador de profundidade e peso, capaz de entender um erro num nível profundo, e considerar o resultado final antes dos passos, de modo muito pragmático. a autoexpressão pode ser difícil porque você quer mostrar com precisão o que significa, e os outros podem perder a paciência com o que você constrói.
Capricorn.en: with retrograde Mercury in Capricorn, you may be a deep and weighty thinker, able to understand a mistake at a deep level, and consider the end result before the steps, in a very pragmatic way. self-expression may be difficult because you want to show precisely what you mean, and others may lose patience with what you are building.
